Subject: SIG intake: FinNova initial questionnaire

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is FinNova's SIG spreadsheet for 2026 — it's our standard intake for vendors going through procurement and security review. We try to get section-level owners assigned so we can route follow-ups more efficiently.

For this pass we need:
- Section claims (who on your team will own each SIG section)
- Primary evidence artifacts or pointers (e.g., SOC report, config screenshots, retention policy docs, links to logs)
- Target delivery dates for any missing evidence (ideally within two weeks)

I've attached FinNova_SIG_Request_2026.xlsx. Can you confirm an initial list of owners and expected delivery dates by EOD Friday (2026-06-05)? If you prefer, a short owner roster CSV is fine.

Appreciate it — we have a compliance review kickoff on 2026-06-17 and want to present a clean owner map.

Best,
Asha Reddy
Security Engagement Lead
FinNova

Attachment: FinNova_SIG_Request_2026.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

- Section B (Data Classification & Handling): mina_haddad — evidence: data classification policy, retention policy doc, sample S3 config — due 2026-06-09
- Section C (Access & Identity): aditya_rao — evidence: RBAC diagrams, Okta reports, privileged access review export — due 2026-06-09
- Section D (Runtime / Infrastructure Controls): marissa_cole — evidence: infra diagrams, network segmentation notes, instance baseline config — due 2026-06-10

I've attached a simple roster csv (sig-owners-roster-20260603.csv) and a short evidence checklist (evidence-checklist-logs-and-backups.md) with suggested artifacts. If you have a different delivery estimate, reply with your date.

Asha — if you need a different split or want to consolidate owners, say the word. If we can provide links (Drive) rather than zipped attachments, we'd prefer that.

Next steps:
1) Team confirms owners/dates by EOD Fri 2026-06-05
2) Populate Drive folder and share with audit@finnova.com
3) I'll do a quick internal review and then send the completed SIG to Asha.

Thanks — Karthik
